g.text: Domain Model Excerpt - WEB03 Role-Based Navigation (User Aggregate)
- UserId is a unique identifier for a user.
- The SPA never sends another user's id
Guest is NOT a role: it is the absence
of an authenticated session and gives
access only to the public sections.
What WEB03 reads from this aggregate
(always through GET /api/v1/auth/me, never from the JWT)
- roles: the set of sections shown in the menu is the UNION
of the sections granted to each role (Table 1).
- active: an inactive account, or an account with no role,
sees only the public sections plus an access-denied message.
- It never changes roles or the active state (AA06 / AA07).
- It never decides authorization on its own: hiding a menu
option is always complemented by the back-end check
- "Navigation section" is a presentation concept of the SPA
(frontend/src/navigation), not a domain concept, and is
therefore not part of the domain model.
